## Utah State University

I am in the process of adapting and improving [Statistcal Computing in R and Python](../stat-computing-r-python/) to teach USU's graduate statistical computing class in R and Python.

In addition, I've been teaching [Stat 1080](https://srvanderplas.github.io/stat1080)/CIVC 1010 - Data and the Stories They Tell, which covers an introduction to R programming and basic statistical concepts such as p-values, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and regression. The course has no prerequisites and is intended to be accessible to everyone, regardless of math background, because data literacy is a basic component of being a functional citizen in the modern world. 

## University of Nebraska - Lincoln

I wrote and continue to update/improve a textbook, [Statistical Computing in R and Python](../stat-computing-r-python/), which I used for Stat 151, 251, 351, and 850 at the University of Nebraska. 

Note that these courses are no longer being taught or updated after the elimination of the Statistics department at University of Nebraska on December 5, 2025.
